title: Send me CATS
author: Visible-Key-1320
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/kcr9oinvp32g1.png?width=1724&format=png&auto=webp&s=af92215b5976080a6ea90cabfd317692070ff089

We're making a visual novel about cats, and this is our character creation screen. We're using image gen to give players a bunch of options for what their character could look like (for development, not integrated in the game), so I thought it might be fun to ask r/aigamedev for cat pics. 

If you want to see what your cat would look like in a visual novel, send me a pic (either DM me or post here). I'll credit you by your username unless otherwise specified! Pets will also be credited.

Will post results when they are ready!
